evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-checker
evals.prompt: A hook notice says node or jq is missing for instruction-placement. What is missing?
evals.expected_output: Runs /instruction-placement:check-prerequisites, reports each PASS/FAIL row with the install hint the checker printed, and stops. Installs nothing.
expectations: Runs `lib/prerequisites.sh check` or the PowerShell stub with the same arguments
Reports every FAIL row with the install hint the checker printed
Does not install Node.js or jq and does not edit prerequisites.json

evals.name: passing-check-names-the-rule-gate
evals.expected_output: When every row passes, reports the rows and stops. The rule-glob gate stays /instruction-placement:check.
expectations: Reports the rows the checker printed
On all PASS, does not install anything
Does not treat this skill as the rule-glob gate
